blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Captured document images often suffer from diverse degradations caused by uncontrolled imaging conditions, which reduce readability and obscure fine text structures. Single-degradation restoration methods are usually trained and deployed for individual degradation types, and therefore require model selection before restoration. Unified restoration models alleviate the need to maintain multiple restoration networks by sharing one network across tasks, but representative unified document image restoration methods still depend on external task selection. This dependency limits automatic document image restoration. We propose DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified restoration network that derives restoration guidance directly from the input image. It introduces a Degradation Perception Module (DPM) to extract degradation representations and predict degradation weights, and Degradation Prior-guided Adaptive Feature Fusion (DP-AFF) to combine learnable degradation priors with degradation features extracted from the input. The resulting guidance is injected into a shared restoration backbone, enabling adaptive restoration without external task selection. DocDUR-Net also supports a manual mode with explicit task selection. Experiments on document image restoration benchmarks show that DocDUR-Net achieves the best average PSNR of 29.405 dB and SSIM of 0.960 among unified methods while remaining competitive with single-degradation methods.
blocks.zh: 被捕获的文件图像往往因不受控制的成像条件而出现不同的退化,降低了可读性并模糊了文字结构. 单降解还原方法通常是针对个别降解类型进行训练和部署的,因此在恢复前需要模型选择. 统一恢复模型通过共享一个跨任务的网络来缓解维持多个恢复网络的需要,但代表性的统一文档图像恢复方法仍然依赖于外部任务选择. 这种依赖性限制了自动文档图像恢复. 我们提出DocDUR-Net,这是一个退化意识的统一恢复网络,直接取自输入图像的恢复指导. 它引入了可降解感官模块(DPM)来提取可降解性能并预测可降解性能的分量,以及可降解性能的先导适应性融合(DP-AFF),将可被学习的可降解性前兆与从输入中提取的可降解性能结合起来。 由此产生的指导意见被注入一个共享的恢复主干线,从而能够在不选择外部任务的情况下进行适应性恢复。 DocDUR-Net也支持带有明确任务选择的手动模式. 对文件图像恢复基准的实验表明,DocDUR-Net在统一方法中实现了29.405 dB和0.960的SSIM的最佳平均PSNR,同时仍然与单降解方法具有竞争力.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Document image restoration aims to recover readable document images from degraded captures [ 30 , 27 ] . In real-world acquisition scenarios, document images may suffer from shadows, blur, and specular highlights caused by uncontrolled illumination, camera motion, or reflective materials [ 23 , 19 , 26 ] . These degradations can obscure text regions and corrupt stroke structures, underscoring the need for effective restoration methods.
blocks.zh: 文件图像恢复旨在从退化的捕获中取回可读文件图像[30,27]. 在现实世界的获取情景中,文件图像可能受阴影、模糊和光谱突出的影响,其原因可能是无控制的照明、相机运动或反射材料[23、19、26]。 这些退化可能模糊文字区域和腐败的中风结构,突出表明需要有效的恢复方法。

blocks.en: Single-degradation document image restoration methods usually focus on one degradation type. Dedicated models are designed and trained for document shadow removal [ 9 , 7 ] , document image deblurring [ 4 , 12 ] , and document specular highlight removal [ 3 , 21 ] . While effective for their target degradations, this paradigm relies on separately trained models and requires model selection before restoration, as shown in Fig. 1 (a). Task-specified unified document image restoration methods share one model across tasks, reducing the need to train multiple restoration networks. However, existing unified methods still require explicit task selection before restoration, as shown in Fig. 1 (b).
blocks.zh: 单降解文件图像恢复方法通常侧重于一种降解类型. 专门模型的设计和训练是为了清除文件阴影[9,7],去除文件图像[4,12],以及分光分光清除[3,21]。 这种模式虽然对目标退化有效,但依赖经过单独培训的模式,在恢复前需要选择模式,如图1(a)所示。 任务指定的统一文件图像恢复方法共享一个模式跨任务,减少了培训多个恢复网络的需要. 然而,如图1(b)所示,现有的统一方法仍然需要在恢复前明确选择任务。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of document image restoration paradigms using shadow removal as an example. (a) Single-degradation restoration requires selecting a dedicated model for the target degradation. (b) Task-specified unified restoration uses one restoration model but still requires task selection. (c) DocDUR-Net extracts degradation information for automatic restoration while retaining explicit task selection in manual mode.
blocks.zh: 图1:以去影为例对文档图像恢复范式进行比较. (a) 单一降解恢复需要为目标降解选择一个专用模型。 (b) 指定任务的统一恢复使用一种恢复模式,但仍需要选择任务。 (c) DocDUR-Net为自动恢复提取降解信息,同时保留人工模式的明确任务选择。

blocks.en: We therefore propose DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified restoration network that performs automatic restoration by extracting degradation information from the input image, as shown in Fig. 1 (c). DocDUR-Net consists of a shared restoration backbone and two degradation-aware components. The Degradation Perception Module (DPM) extracts multi-scale degradation information and predicts degradation weights, while Degradation Prior-guided Adaptive Feature Fusion (DP-AFF) combines learnable degradation priors with the input degradation feature and injects the resulting guidance into the backbone. DocDUR-Net operates in automatic mode by default, while retaining a manual mode with explicit task selection for controlled evaluation and task-specified restoration.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议DocDUR-Net,这是一个具有降解意识的统一恢复网络,通过从输入图像中提取降解信息来进行自动恢复,如图1(c)所示。 DocDUR-Net包括一个共享的恢复骨干和两个降解意识组件. 降解感知模块(DPM)提取了多尺度降解信息并预测了降解权重,而降解先导适应性特征融合(DP-AFF)结合了可学习的降解前科和输入降解特征,并注入了由此产生的导入骨干. DocDUR-Net默认以自动模式运行,同时保留一个手动模式,明确任务选择,用于受控评价和任务指定的还原.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We propose DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified restoration method that enables automatic document image restoration by deriving restoration guidance from the input image, while retaining a manual mode with explicit task selection. • We design DPM and DP-AFF to transform degradation perception into adaptive restoration guidance. DPM predicts degradation weights from the input image, and DP-AFF fuses learnable priors with input degradation features to guide the shared restoration backbone. • Experiments on representative benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DocDUR-Net. It achieves the best average PSNR and SSIM among unified methods while remaining competitive with single-degradation methods.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们提议DocDUR-Net,一种降解意识的统一恢复方法,通过从输入图像中取出恢复指导,使自动文档图像恢复成为可能,同时保留一种手动模式,明确任务选择。 我们设计了DPM和DP-AFF,将降解感知转化为适应性恢复指导. DPM从输入图像中预测降解分量,而DP-AFF引信可以学习具有输入降解特性的前科来引导共享的还原主干线. • 关于代表性基准的实验表明DocDUR-Net的有效性。 它在统一方法中实现了最佳平均水平的PSNR和SSIM,同时保持与单降解方法的竞争.

blocks.en: We propose DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified restoration method that enables automatic document image restoration by deriving restoration guidance from the input image, while retaining a manual mode with explicit task selection.
blocks.zh: 我们提议DocDUR-Net是一种降解意识统一恢复方法,通过从输入图像中取出恢复指导,实现自动文档图像恢复,同时保留一个手动模式,并明确任务选择。

blocks.en: We design DPM and DP-AFF to transform degradation perception into adaptive restoration guidance. DPM predicts degradation weights from the input image, and DP-AFF fuses learnable priors with input degradation features to guide the shared restoration backbone.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了DPM和DP-AFF,将降解感知转化为适应性恢复指导. DPM从输入图像中预测降解分量,而DP-AFF引信可以学习具有输入降解特性的前科来引导共享的还原主干线.

blocks.en: Experiments on representative benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of DocDUR-Net. It achieves the best average PSNR and SSIM among unified methods while remaining competitive with single-degradation methods.
blocks.zh: 关于代表性基准的实验表明DocDUR-Net的有效性。 它在统一方法中实现了最佳平均水平的PSNR和SSIM,同时保持与单降解方法的竞争.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Single-Degradation Document Image Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.1 单降解文件图像修复

blocks.en: Single-degradation document image restoration methods usually design specialized networks for a specific degradation. For document deblurring, representative methods [ 4 , 12 ] use large receptive fields or direct image regression to recover sharp character strokes. For document shadow removal, FSENet [ 7 ] combines Transformer blocks [ 17 ] with frequency decomposition, and DocDeshadower [ 31 ] removes shadows through attention aggregation and gated fusion. For document specular highlight removal, HAFNet [ 5 ] adopts hierarchical adaptive filtering, while DocSHRNet [ 21 ] incorporates document structure and adaptive receptive fields. These methods are effective for their target degradations, but extending them to different restoration tasks requires separately trained models and model selection before inference.
blocks.zh: 单降解文件图像恢复方法通常为特定的降解设计出专门的网络. 对于文档去blurring,代表性方法[4,12]使用大的可接受字段或直接图像回归来恢复尖锐的字符中风. 对于文档阴影去除,FSENet [7] 将变形器块 [17] 与频率分解结合,DocDeshadower [31] 通过注意力聚合和入门聚变来去除阴影. 对于文件分光突出去除,HAFNet[5]采用了分层次的适应性过滤,而DocSHRNet[21]则纳入了文件结构和适应性可接受领域。 这些方法对于它们的目标退化是有效的,但将其推广到不同的恢复任务需要经过单独训练的模型和模型选择后才能推断.

blocks.en: Some document restoration frameworks use broadly applicable restoration architectures for different document restoration tasks [ 15 , 22 , 1 , 11 ] . However, they are still trained and used separately for each task. This motivates unified document image restoration methods that handle different restoration tasks within a single model.
blocks.zh: 一些文件恢复框架对不同的文件恢复任务使用广泛适用的恢复架构[15,22,1,11]. 然而,他们仍然接受培训,并被单独用于每项任务。 这激励了统一文档图像恢复方法,在单一模型内处理不同的恢复任务.

blocks.en: 2.2 Unified Document Image Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.2 统一文档图像恢复

blocks.en: Unified modeling has been widely studied in document processing [ 16 , 18 , 28 ] . In document image restoration, unified methods handle different restoration tasks with a shared model. DocRes [ 25 ] is a representative unified model that constructs dynamic visual prompts for different tasks and concatenates them with the degraded input to guide the restoration network. Uni-DocDiff [ 29 ] extends unified document restoration to diffusion models, using learnable task prompts to condition the iterative restoration process. These methods reduce the need to maintain separate restoration networks, but the restoration task is still selected externally for each input image. Their restoration process depends on externally specified task information rather than degradation information derived from the input image.
blocks.zh: 文件处理中广泛研究了统一模型[16,18,28]. 在文档图像恢复中,统一的方法用共享模型处理不同的恢复任务. DocRes [25]是一个具有代表性的统一模型,用于构建不同任务的动态视觉提示并用已退化的输入来调和来引导恢复网络. Uni-DocDiff [29] 将统一的文档还原扩展至扩散模型,使用可学习的任务提示来条件迭代还原过程. 这些方法减少了维持单独的恢复网络的需要,但恢复任务仍为每个输入图像的外部选择. 它们的恢复过程取决于外部指定的任务信息,而不是从输入图像得到的降解信息.

blocks.en: In contrast, DocDUR-Net incorporates degradation perception into unified restoration and guides restoration with degradation information extracted from the input image, while retaining a manual mode with explicit task selection.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,DocDUR-Net将降解感知纳入统一恢复,并用从输入图像中提取的降解信息指导恢复,同时保留一个手动模式,并明确任务选择.

blocks.en: 3.4 Inference Modes
blocks.zh: 3.4 推论模式

blocks.en: DocDUR-Net primarily operates in automatic mode, as shown in Fig. 2 and Fig. 4 . In this mode, DPM predicts w deg w_{\mathrm{deg}} from the input image, and DP-AFF uses it to aggregate the degradation prior and guide the backbone. This enables unified restoration without external task selection.
blocks.zh: DocDUR-Net主要以自动模式运行,如图2和图4所示. 在此模式下, DPM 从输入图像中预测 w deg w_{\ mathrm{ deg}}, 而 DP-AFF 则用它来将退化在前并引导骨干. 这样就可以在没有外部任务选择的情况下统一恢复.

blocks.en: Manual mode serves as an optional protocol for controlled evaluation and restoration with explicit task selection. In this mode, the selected task is mapped to degradation weights in place of the DPM prediction, while the remaining restoration process is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 手动模式是具有明确任务选择的可控评价和恢复的任择议定书。 在此模式下,所选任务被映射为降解重量来取而代之的是DPM预测,而其余的还原过程则保持不变.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和任务

blocks.en: We use representative benchmarks for document shadow removal, document image deblurring, and document specular highlight removal. For document shadow removal, we use SD7K [ 7 ] and follow the original split with 6479 training pairs and 760 testing pairs. For document image deblurring, we use TDD [ 4 ] ; following the split used by DocRes [ 25 ] , we train with 40000 image pairs and test with 1600 image pairs. For document specular highlight removal, we use DocHighlight [ 21 ] , with 1701 training pairs and 500 testing pairs from 2201 high-resolution real paired images. DocDUR-Net is trained as a single unified model on the union of all training sets.
blocks.zh: 我们使用具有代表性的基准来清除文件阴影、去污文件图像、以及光谱突出文件。 对于文件"阴影去除",我们使用SD7K [7],并跟随原分出6479个训练对和760个测试对. 对于文档图像去blurring,我们使用TDD [4];在DocRes [25]使用的分出后,我们用40000个图像对来训练并用1600个图像对来测试. 对于文档光谱突出显示去除,我们使用DocHighlight [21],有1701训练对和从2201高分辨率真配对图像的500个测试对. DocDUR-Net作为所有培训组合的单一统一模式进行培训。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en: We report PSNR and SSIM [ 20 ] between restored images and paired ground truth to measure pixel fidelity and structural similarity. For unified methods, Table 1 also reports average scores over the evaluated tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们报告 PSNR 和 SSIM [20] 在恢复的图像和配对的地面真理之间, 测量像素的忠诚度和结构的相似性。 关于统一方法,表1还报告所评价任务的平均分数。

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented with PyTorch [ 13 ] , using Restormer [ 24 ] as the shared restoration backbone. Training is conducted on four NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs. We use AdamW [ 10 ] with weight decay 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . The degradation feature dimension and prior dimension are set to d = 128 d=128 . The learnable temperature τ \tau is initialized to 1.0 1.0 and constrained to [ 0.1 , 10.0 ] [0.1,10.0] .
blocks.zh: 所有实验均以PyTorch [13] 进行,以再暴机 [24] 为共享恢复主干线. 培训涉及四个NVIDIA RTX A6000GPU. 我们使用 AdamW [10] 有重量衰减 1 × 10 − 4 1 乘以 10 + 4 }。 退化特征维度和先前维度被设定为d=128d=128. 可学习温度\tau被初始化为1.01.0并受 [0.1, 10.0] [0.1, 10.0].

blocks.en: To balance the different dataset sizes, each task dataset is sampled with equal probability during training. DocDUR-Net is trained in two stages. The first stage uses 256 × 256 256\times 256 random crops for 100000 iterations with batch size 4 and learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} . The second stage uses learning rate 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for another 100000 iterations, with batch size 1, 512 × 512 512\times 512 crops for DocHighlight and SD7K, and 256 × 256 256\times 256 crops for TDD. The DPM input is resized to a 768-pixel long side, and random rotation is used for augmentation. For document specular highlight removal, we follow DocSHRNet [ 21 ] and use 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 sliding-window inference with stride 512, while image-level inference is used for shadow removal and deblurring.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡不同的数据集大小,每个任务数据集在训练期间都以相同概率进行抽样. DocDUR-Net分两个阶段培训. 第一阶段使用256×256256相256相随机收成的256相随机收成,可进行分批分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分入分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分出分 第二阶段采用5×10−5相5相5相5相5相10相5相5相5相相再生10相再生10相再生10相再生10相再生1,512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相512相5相5相5相5相256相256相256相256相25相5相相再生的相再生作物. DPM输入被调整为768像素长相,随机旋转用于增强. 对于文档分光突出去除,我们跟随DocSHRNet[21],并使用1024×1024相1024相相滑-窗口推论与出步512相滑-窗口推论,而图像水平推论则用于去影和去污.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 4.4 与现行方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares DocDUR-Net with single-degradation and unified methods. The single-degradation methods include FSENet [ 7 ] and DocDeshadower [ 31 ] for shadow removal, NAF-DPM [ 1 ] and DocWaveDiff [ 11 ] for deblurring, and HAFNet [ 5 ] and DocSHRNet [ 21 ] for document specular highlight removal. Unified methods include UPOCR [ 14 ] and DocRes [ 25 ] . We obtain the results of DocDeshadower, NAF-DPM, UPOCR, and DocRes by retraining the corresponding methods. The remaining competing results are taken from their original papers. UPOCR provides pixel-level outputs for document processing tasks, while DocRes uses task prompts for unified restoration. UPOCR and DocRes are evaluated with explicit task selection, whereas DocDUR-Net is evaluated in automatic mode.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了DocDUR-Net与单降解和统一方法. 单降解方法包括FSENet [7]和DocDeshadower [31]用于去影,NAF-DPM [1]和DocWaveDiff [11]用于去污,而HAFNet [5]和DocSHRNet [21]用于去光谱突出显示文件. 统一的方法包括UPOCR [14]和DocRes [25]. 我们通过对相应方法的再培训,获得DocDeshadower、NAF-DPM、UPOCR和DocRes的结果。 其余的相竞结果取自其原始论文. UPOCR为文件处理任务提供像素级输出,而DocRes则使用任务提示来统一恢复. 以明确的任务选择评价UPOCR和DocRes,而DocDUR-Net则以自动模式评价.

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantitative comparison on shadow removal, deblurring, and document specular highlight removal benchmarks. Best and second-best results in each task metric column are marked in bold and underlined. Average scores are reported for unified methods.
blocks.zh: 表1:阴影去除、去污分解和文件光谱分辨去除基准的定量比较。 每个任务衡量栏的最佳和次最佳成果以粗体和下划线标出。 报告统一方法的平均分数。

blocks.en: Without external task selection, DocDUR-Net achieves the highest average PSNR and SSIM among unified methods, with scores of 29.405 dB and 0.960. On shadow removal and deblurring, it also outperforms the single-degradation methods in both PSNR and SSIM. On specular highlight removal, DocSHRNet obtains the highest PSNR and SSIM, followed by DocDUR-Net, which surpasses HAFNet and the other unified methods. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of DocDUR-Net for unified document image restoration.
blocks.zh: 没有外部任务选择,DocDUR-Net在统一方法中实现最高平均PSNR和SSIM,得分29.405分B和0.960分. 在去影和去污方面,它也超过了PSNR和SSIM中的单降解方法. 在分光突出去除上,DocSHRNet获得最高的PSNR和SSIM,其次是DocDUR-Net,它超过了HAFNet和其他统一的方法. 这些结果表明DocDUR-Net在统一文档图像恢复方面的有效性.

blocks.en: Figs. 5 , 6 , and 7 show qualitative comparisons on the three restoration tasks. DocDUR-Net removes shadows while preserving document details, reconstructs sharper character strokes for deblurring, and suppresses specular highlights with fewer visible artifacts.
blocks.zh: 图5、图6和图7对三项修复任务进行了定性比较。 DocDUR-Net在保留文档细节的同时去除阴影,重建更锋利的字符中风来去blurring,并用较少可见文物来压制分光亮.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 2 studies the contribution of DPM and DP-AFF. The baseline is the shared restoration backbone trained jointly on all tasks without explicit degradation perception. With DPM alone, the degradation feature is directly projected and added to backbone features. DPM improves the average PSNR from 28.144 dB to 29.256 dB, indicating that input degradation information is useful for unified restoration. DP-AFF further improves the average PSNR to 29.405 dB by combining input degradation features with learnable degradation priors. The full model improves the average PSNR by 1.261 dB with only a 2.3% parameter increase.
blocks.zh: 表2研究DPM和DP-AFF的贡献。 基线是在所有任务上共同培训的共同恢复骨干,没有明显的退化感。 仅依靠DPM,退化特征直接被预测并被加入到骨干特征中. DPM将平均PSNR从28.144分贝改进为29.256分贝,表明输入降解信息对统一恢复有用. DP-AFF将输入降解特性与可学习的降解前科相结合,将平均PSNR进一步提高到29.405分贝. 完整的模型将平均PSNR改进了1.261分贝,只增加了2.3%的参数.

blocks.en: Table 2: Ablation results for DPM and DP-AFF.
blocks.zh: 表2:DPM和DP-AFF的配比结果。

blocks.en: 4.6 Analysis of Automatic and Manual Modes
blocks.zh: 4.6 自动和人工模式分析

blocks.en: Table 3 evaluates the degradation weights predicted by DPM. DPM matches all shadow removal and deblurring labels and achieves 99.4% accuracy on document specular highlight removal, reaching 99.9% overall accuracy. This result supports the reliability of automatic mode.
blocks.zh: 表3评价了DPM预测的降解分量. DPM匹配了所有的阴影去除和去污标签,并实现了文档光谱突出去除的99.4%的精度,达到99.9%的整体精度. 这一结果支持了自动模式的可靠性.

blocks.en: Table 3: Degradation perception accuracy of DPM.
blocks.zh: 表3:DPM的降解感知精度。

blocks.en: We further compare automatic and manual modes. In automatic mode, the predicted degradation weights are used to construct the restoration guidance, whereas manual mode uses weights determined by the selected task. The results are identical on shadow removal and deblurring, with only a marginal PSNR difference of 0.071 dB on document specular highlight removal. This difference is consistent with Table 3 , where all misclassified samples come from the specular highlight removal test set.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步比较自动模式和人工模式。 在自动模式下,使用预测的降解分量来构建还原导出,而手动模式则使用由所选任务决定的分量. 在去影和去色上结果完全相同,在文件分光分光去色上只有0.071分贝的边际PSNR差. 这一差异与表3一致,其中所有被错误分类的样本都来自光谱亮度去除测试集.

blocks.en: Fig. 8 visualizes all three specular highlight removal test samples assigned to shadow removal by DPM. These samples also contain visible shadow regions. In automatic mode, DocDUR-Net suppresses the shadowed areas while preserving readable text. With explicit selection of specular highlight removal, manual mode more directly suppresses reflective regions. This comparison shows that automatic mode remains reliable without external task selection, while manual mode provides flexible restoration control.
blocks.zh: 图8可视化出由DPM指定去影的三相光谱突出取出试样. 这些样本还含有可见的阴影区域. 在自动模式下,DocDUR-Net在保存可读文本的同时会压制阴影区域. 通过明确选择光谱亮度去除,人工模式更直接地压制反射区域. 这种比较表明,没有外部任务选择,自动模式仍然可靠,而手动模式则提供灵活的恢复控制.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Visual comparison of automatic and manual modes for the three specular highlight removal test samples assigned to shadow removal by DPM.
blocks.zh: 图 8:视觉上比较DPM指定去影的三种光谱突出取出测试样本的自动和人工模式.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This paper presents DocDUR-Net, a degradation-aware unified document image restoration method. It extracts degradation information from the input image and uses DPM and DP-AFF to guide a shared restoration backbone, enabling automatic restoration without external task selection. The method also retains a manual mode for flexible restoration control. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of DocDUR-Net for degradation-aware unified document image restoration.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍多克杜尔-网络(DocDUR-Net),一种降解-意识统一的文档图像恢复方法. 它从输入图像中提取降解信息,并使用DPM和DP-AFF来引导共享的恢复主干线,使得无需外部任务选择就可以自动恢复. 该方法还保留了灵活恢复控制的人工模式. 实验结果表明DocDUR-Net对降解感知统一文件图像恢复的有效性。
